mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an active monetary easing cycle that reduces the risk-free rate, thereby increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% in the prior month signals deteriorating labor market conditions that increase recession risk, thereby reducing corporate earnings expectations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the unemployment rate and decline in payroll employment signals a severe labor market contraction, which increases the probability of a recession and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 1 month and PAYEMS declines > 50k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises by at least 0.3pp and PAYEMS declines by at least 50k in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-recession recovery phase, a rise in housing starts above the 12-month moving average signals accelerating economic activity, which boosts corporate revenue growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during the post-recession recovery phase when HOUST rises above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production over the prior month signals a contraction in the real economy, which reduces corporate output and profits, thereby producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months where INDPRO declines from the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 2.0% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, thereby producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales signals robust consumer spending and economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 0.5% in 1 month and RSAFS rises > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises by at least 0.5% and RSAFS rises by at least 0.3% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In the context of a supply shock, a decline in industrial production signals a severe contraction in manufacturing output, which increases economic uncertainty and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during a supply shock when INDPRO declines from the prior month.
